item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba thugs gyi sgrub pa sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pa chen po'i khog dbub thabs kyi phyag bzhes 'dod dgu'i sprin chen mchog thun snye ma
item.coloph: zhes rig 'dzin sku gsum dgongs 'dus tshom bu tshogs bsgrub chen po'i phyag bzhes mchog thun snye ma zhes bya ba 'di ni rgyal ba'i slob dpon grub pa'i shing rta chen po bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa dang / rig 'dzin za rang rnam 'phrul sangs rgyas gnyis pa dngos byon sogs kyi gter rnying skyong zhing gter gsar spel ba'i lag len zin bris ring lugs ltas chog cha lag cha rkyen sogs dag snang chen po'i bstan btsas smin nges dgos pa'i bka' nan spyi bor coSh+pa (cot+pan) bcing ste/ nye bar bka' babs rigs mchog khyung gser sgar chung lcam dral dang / yongs 'dzin mchog dga'i skyes sprul bla slob zung dang / khyad par nye gnas tshul khrims dbang rgyal sogs kyi dngos rdzas rab dkar me tog gis mtshams sbyar te lung mthun Dak+ki'i brda lung yol med dge byed khang chib nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs dang po'i rab dga' 'char ba'i nyin du/ rigs sngags 'dzin pa pad+ma bdud 'dul gyi (gyis) lung rig bden gnyis zab mo'i rgyud lung mang po gsher te gdan thog gcig du sbyar ba'i drung yig pa ni seng ha nyi ri'i sgo gsum sor mo'i zlos gar dad gsum spyi bor bzlum ste zhal rlang yol med du bgyis pa 'dis kyang / gsang sngags bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub zab mo phyogs kun dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
